name: Space and satellite operators
description: New CVEs and KEV entries that name satellite-communications vendors, and one actor whose use of satellite links a vendor has reported. Vigil has no space sector, so leak-site claims against operators are not matched by sector; a vendor name is matched anywhere in a CVE's product or description.

rules.rule_name: Satellite vendors: new high and critical CVEs

entities.name: Turla
entities.note: Kaspersky reported in September 2015 that Turla used hijacked satellite internet links to hide its command-and-control servers.
